sourceMappings.entranceVariants: Source page module defines opacity/y/blur and scale entrances, once-only visibility threshold 0.35, grouped child stagger 0.13s with 0.12s delay, and a second group delay of 3.25s. bridge.js maps the source entrance variants to 900ms default, 1000ms scale, 800ms gallery, 700ms contact, 600ms wish, and 550ms palette entrances.
sourceMappings.cornerOrnaments: Source corner ornaments reveal with scale and opacity; bridge uses 800ms ease-out to 0.85 opacity.
sourceMappings.heroImage: Source scale 1.16 to 1 over 10s with ease-out.
sourceMappings.calendarDay: Source Framer spring specifies stiffness 220 and damping 15. bridge.js samples the unit-mass damped response into 24 Web Animations keyframe intervals over 400ms.
sourceMappings.giftCard: Source 3D card entrance is retained; source sheen translates from -120% to 220% over 3.6s with ease-in-out, then holds 2.4s before repeating. bridge.js represents the hold as a keyframe plateau in a 6s cycle.
sourceMappings.divider: Source sheen translates -110% to 110% over 2.8s, repeats infinitely in reverse with ease-in-out.
sourceMappings.openingOrnament: Source rotates the star over 8s linearly and pulses the floral ornament over 3.5s ease-in-out.
sourceMappings.countdownHeart: Source heart pulse scales 1 to 1.2 to 1 and changes opacity over 4s ease-in-out.
sourceMappings.openingAndScrollCue: Opening overlay, curtain and title timings are mapped above; scroll cue fades in after 3.45s and bobs on an 1.8s loop.
sourceMappings.galleryAndLists: Source entrance timings are mapped for gallery images, wishes, contacts, and palette swatches; gallery interaction settings are recorded under sourceGallery.

sourceMotion.adaptation: The source component chunk is audited and its motion timings are mapped in bridge.js using the local Web Animations API and canvas; source CSS chunks are verified after line-ending normalization. Reduced motion reveals content immediately and skips opening and loops.

sourceGallery.component: PhotoSwipe-style lightbox with slideshow, thumbnails, zoom, swipe, keyboard navigation, backdrop close, and a slide counter
sourceGallery.adaptation: The Chorlove component is coupled to its bundled app runtime, so bridge.js implements these source-visible controls and settings against creator gallery images. Gallery items remain creator-provided; unrelated captured Orchid Amplop sample images are excluded.
